app.name: Word Quizzer
app.storageFull: Your browser storage is full, so recent progress was not saved. Delete a quiz you no longer need, or export it to JSON first.

library.title: Your quizzes
library.empty: No quizzes yet. Add a JSON file or create a new quiz.
library.confirmDelete: Delete "{{title}}" and its progress? Export it first if you want to keep the results.
library.knownInfo: A question is known once you have answered it correctly 4 times in a row. One wrong answer and it counts as not known again. With the question list "Leave out questions you know" you practise only the rest.

errors.noItems: the file contains no questions with answers.
errors.jsonInvalid: the file is not valid JSON.

editor.filterHint: Text, or a regular expression like ^de .*$
editor.question: Question
editor.confirmReset: Reset all progress and results for this quiz?
editor.title: Title
editor.entryHint: Separate alternative answers with a semicolon (;). Press Enter in the last answer to add the next question.
editor.incomplete: Rows missing a question or an answer: {{count}}. They are left out of tests and exports until you fill them in.
editor.remarkInfo: Extra information about a question, such as a grammar hint or an example sentence. It isn't shown while you answer, because it could give the answer away. You see it after a wrong answer, in Presentation, and after "Show answer" in Practice without typing. It doesn't affect checking or the score.

testTypeHelp.presentation: Read through the questions and answers at your own pace. Nothing is scored.
testTypeHelp.asEntered: Type the answer to each question.
testTypeHelp.puzzle: The letters of the answer are scrambled. Put them back in order.
testTypeHelp.mcSimilar: Pick the right answer from options that look like it.
testTypeHelp.mcRandom: Pick the right answer from random options.
testTypeHelp.mental: Think of the answer, reveal it, and say whether you knew it.
testTypeHelp.dictation: The answer is shown. Type it over.
testTypeHelp.englishTeacher: The hardest mode: one wrong keystroke and the answer counts as wrong.

repetitionHelp.none: Each question once. Afterwards you can practise your mistakes.
repetitionHelp.repeatList: The list starts over until you stop.
repetitionHelp.untilAllCorrect: Wrong answers come back in the next round until you get them all right.
repetitionHelp.interval: Spaced repetition: right answers come back later, wrong ones sooner. After 4 right in a row a question is done.

settings.rewardHelp: Every {{every}} correct answers: a Flappy Bird break of up to {{seconds}} seconds.
settings.title: Test settings

test.noQuestions: No questions match this question list. Choose another question list.
test.puzzleHint: Click the letters or type the answer.
test.settingsChanged: Settings changed, so the test started again.

results.title: Test finished
results.bonusRule: Every 5 bonus points count as one extra correct answer.
results.presentationDone: You've seen every question. Choose a test type to test yourself.
results.historyEmpty: Your results will show up here.
results.chartLabel: Score per test, oldest to newest

game.title: Break time: Flappy Bird
game.ready: Press Space or tap to flap
game.canvasLabel: Flappy Bird game. Press Space, the up arrow, or tap to flap.

bulk.title: Add several questions
bulk.help: One question per line. Separate the question and the answer with a tab (as when pasting from a spreadsheet), = or " - ". An optional third part becomes the note. Separate alternative answers with ;.
bulk.placeholder:
the dog = de hond
the cat = de kat; de poes
the horse - het paard - neuter
bulk.skipped: Skipped lines without a question and an answer: {{lines}}
